# Research evidence file — Trinh Phan-Canh

Last reviewed: 01 September 2026. This source file is supplied to the website research assistant as an evidence index. It records claims that should be answered from primary or reputable public sources, not from model memory.

## Current position

- Trinh Phan-Canh is a postdoctoral researcher in the laboratory of Sizun Jiang at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC) and Harvard Medical School.
- Research focus: spatial multi-omics approaches to host–disease interactions, pathogenic adaptation, and tissue-specific responses.
- Primary links: https://sizunjianglab.com/ ; https://www.bidmc.org/ ; https://www.phancanhtrinh.com/

## Doctoral training

- PhD in Molecular Genetics and Immunology, Medical University of Vienna and Max Perutz Labs Vienna, completed in 2025 with Excellence.
- Doctoral advisor: Karl Kuchler.
- Doctoral research concerned virulence and antifungal drug resistance in *Candida auris*.
- Public sources: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39405274/ ; https://www.phancanhtrinh.com/pdfs/papers/PCT_CV.pdf

## Selected scientific contributions

- *Candida auris* skin tropism and antifungal resistance are mediated by carbonic anhydrase Nce103. Nature Microbiology. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41564-025-02189-z . Public institutional record: https://ucrisportal.univie.ac.at/en/publications/icandida-aurisi-skin-tropism-and-antifungal-resistance-are-mediat/
- The work links CO2 sensing and carbonic anhydrase Nce103 to fungal fitness on skin and antifungal tolerance; detailed mechanistic claims should be checked against the original article.
- White-Brown switching controls phenotypic plasticity and virulence of *Candida auris*. Cell Reports (2025), 115976. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.celrep.2025.115976
- Do morphogenetic switching and intraspecies variation enhance virulence of *Candida auris*? PLOS Pathogens (2024), e1012559. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.ppat.1012559 ; PubMed: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39405274/
- Octenidine effectively reduces *Candida auris* colonisation on human skin. Scientific Reports (2025). Full text: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12297581/
- Public transcriptomic dataset for the CO2-sensing pathway study: GEO GSE253332, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE253332

## Awards and public coverage

- Austrian Microbiology Prize 2026, awarded by the Austrian Society for Hygiene, Microbiology and Preventive Medicine (ÖGHMP) for the Nature Microbiology *Candida auris* study. Official MedUni Vienna announcement: https://www.meduniwien.ac.at/web/en/about-us/news/2026/news-in-june-2026/trinh-phan-canh-receives-the-2026-austrian-microbiology-prize/
- Vietnam Outstanding Young Faces nomination (2025): https://tienphong.vn/de-cu-giai-thuong-guong-mat-tre-viet-nam-tieu-bieu-nam-2025-phan-canh-trinh-post1822610.tpo
- ASEA-UNINET Bernd Rode Award documentation: https://asea-uninet.org/wp-content/uploads/Plenary-Meeting-2024-Minutes.pdf

## Answering rules

- Distinguish present position at BIDMC/HMS from prior doctoral work at Max Perutz Labs and Medical University of Vienna.
- Prefer the original paper, PubMed/DOI, official institution, or official award announcement. Do not turn a news headline into an unsupported scientific claim.
- When a question asks about an exact role, lab, paper, award, or mechanism, provide the direct answer first and cite the relevant link.
